$comment: Release compatibility manifest v2. Pins BOTH SHAs of the canonical release candidate. Two-phase contract: (1) a metadata-only CANDIDATE pin commit sets web.pinned_sha / dcs.pinned_sha to the candidate pair; (2) scripts/release_verifier.sh is fail-closed against these pins (the requested --web-sha/--dcs-sha MUST equal web.pinned_sha/dcs.pinned_sha or verification refuses before any expensive step) and is run from that clean tree; (3) a PASS promotes the candidate pin to the verified pin, a FAIL restores the previous verified pin and no deploy happens. The verifier always clones and re-verifies the pinned Web SHA itself, so the Web self-pin inside the verified tree is not required — only the DCS pin inside that tree is cross-checked.

runtime.note: Node 24 = canonical verification/CI runtime (verifier and verify_release_local refuse other majors). Node v22.23.2 = observed production runtime. Production runtime is NOT changed by this manifest; it is recorded from server inspection only.
